notes:
What's new in 3.6.1:
- Fixed: the version number in the bottom-right corner was wrong. It was hardcoded and had drifted two releases behind - it now always reflects the version you are actually running.
- Update reminders are no longer permanent: "Skip this version" became "Remind me in a week", so an update you postpone comes back instead of disappearing forever. If you previously skipped a version for good, you will be offered the current one again.
- The app now also checks for updates when you come back to the window, not only at startup - useful if you keep it open for days.
- Groundwork for required updates: builds older than a supported minimum can now be told to update before continuing.
